scope: R20 corrects a sightline diagram/source-coordinate mismatch and records separate panorama positions. No building geometry, materials, transforms, or placement changed.

facade_sightline.source: Google Street View, 417 Northwestern Ave, West Lafayette, Indiana
facade_sightline.visual_observation: The 2025 pano shows brick-heavy facade massing and thin horizontal glazing with broad opaque brick interruptions on visible portions. Vegetation, distance, perspective, and adjacent walls obscure exact bay count and spacing.
facade_sightline.geometry_decision: The corrected 2025 sightline intersects GIS edge 18. This candidate-face match is approximate and does not resolve exact slit count, window widths, interruption positions, or cadence elsewhere. No modeled window segmentation is changed; the historic photo and Street View remain occluded/perspective imagery rather than a measured elevation.

historical_views_checked.observation: Historical pano has the same broad view; vegetation and perspective do not resolve window count or spacing.
Historical pano has the same broad view; vegetation and perspective do not resolve window count or spacing.

facade_sightline.r19_discrepancy_correction: The R19 JSON camera/ray values came from the Aug 2025 pano. Its SVG accidentally plotted the June 2009 pano camera/ray while labeling it Aug 2025. The two Google pano positions differ by about 1.82 m and their ray intersections by about 1.91 m. R20 keeps them as separate views and regenerates its diagram from the primary 2025 JSON camera position.

archive_research.title: Knoy Hall of Technology records (UA 141), Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
archive_research.finding: Official finding aid says the 1984 records include construction information and a floor plan. The materials are held in a physical archive folder and the page does not expose digitized elevations or drawings.
archive_research.use: Identifies a credible path for future research, but yielded no new downloadable as-built facade or stair geometry in this pass.

archive_research.title: Purdue University Office of Marketing and Media photographs (UA 62), Series 3 finding aid
archive_research.finding: The finding aid lists 1984 contact-sheet/negative material for the New Technology Building (Knoy), including interior and exterior photographs; these are archival holdings, not digitized images on the page.
archive_research.use: Potential future face-specific historic photo source; not available for measurement/registration in this pass.

archive_research.title: Purdue Building Images collection (UA 149), J-K slides
archive_research.finding: The archive finding aid lists Knoy Hall of Technology among slides dated 1984–2000; the referenced slides are physical holdings rather than online scans.

archive_research.title: Engineering and Polytechnic Gateway Formation Study, Existing Knoy Elevations
archive_research.finding: The existing-elevations panel records L1–L4 floor-to-floor height but contains no elevation silhouettes/opening segmentation. It does not resolve the R17 window cadence critique.

archive_research.title: Purdue Archives Historic Facilities and Buildings Database, Knoy Hall photo record
archive_research.finding: The official photo visibly supports brick fields and interrupted slit-like glazing on photographed faces, but has no camera scale, calibrated direction, or registered face ID.

roof_l5_interior_research.roof_l5: No new digital roof plan, measured elevation, or source resolving the GIS 48-ft conflict/L5-vs-roof interpretation was located. Existing DSM remains a broad surface-height check only.
roof_l5_interior_research.interior: No new digitized as-built stair or circulation plan was located. UA 141 identifies a physical floor plan in Archives, and official emergency plan/2018 planning plan remain the available digital references; neither proves complete accessible route continuity.

limitations: Street View sightline location conversion uses the project's approximate tangent-plane origin, not survey control.
The panos are perspective images, partly occluded by trees, and do not establish exact glazing dimensions or cadence.
Archive finding aids establish the existence of material but are not substitutes for inspecting the original drawings or negatives.

r20_correction.status: The primary 2025 camera/ray values in this JSON were correct, but the companion R19 SVG plotted the 2009 panorama camera and ray while labeling it as 2025. Do not use the R19 SVG; use facade_glazing_assignment_r20.svg and evidence_round20.json.

r19_superseded_artifact.status: Superseded. It plotted the June 2009 camera/ray coordinates but labeled them as the Aug 2025 pano. The JSON primary Aug 2025 coordinates were correct.

new_source_search_r20.result: No newly found public source provides a calibrated, face-registered Knoy elevation or window interruption schedule. Geometry remains unchanged.

leads.title: UA 62 Purdue University Office of Marketing and Media photographs, Series 3 finding aid

leads.source_date: Finding aid describes 1985 construction photos and a rendering for the New Technology Building (Knoy); opened-building photos from 1989 are also listed.
leads.finding: The record identifies potentially useful historical images, but the catalog result does not expose calibrated, face-identified image files suitable for window-to-model assignment.
leads.use: Follow-up archive lead only; no geometry inference.

leads.title: Engineering and Polytechnic Gateway Formation Study, Existing Knoy Elevations
leads.crs: Diagrammatic elevations, not a registered survey/elevation set.
leads.finding: Text describes alternating brick panels punctuated by stone or precast concrete and gives floor-to-floor height marks; it does not supply identifiable facade opening coordinates or exact glazing interruptions.
leads.use: Material and broad rhythm context only; insufficient to alter window segmentation.
